args.sql:
WITH RegionalPurchases AS (
    SELECT
        m.region,
        STRFTIME(strptime(t.txn_date, '%d-%m-%Y'), '%Y') AS year,
        t.quantity * p.price AS total_cost,
        t.quantity
    FROM bank_sales_trading.main.bitcoin_transactions t
    JOIN bank_sales_trading.main.bitcoin_members m ON t.member_id = m.member_id
    JOIN bank_sales_trading.main.bitcoin_prices p ON t.ticker = p.ticker AND strptime(t.txn_date, '%d-%m-%Y') = strptime(p.market_date, '%d-%m-%Y')
    WHERE t.txn_type = 'BUY'
),
AnnualAvgPrice AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        year,
        SUM(total_cost) / SUM(quantity) AS avg_price,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY region ORDER BY year) as rn
    FROM RegionalPurchases
    GROUP BY region, year
),
FilteredAvgPrice AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        year,
        avg_price
    FROM AnnualAvgPrice
    WHERE rn > 1
),
RankedAndLaggedPrice AS (
    SELECT
        year,
        region,
        avg_price,
        RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY year ORDER BY avg_price DESC) as price_rank,
        LAG(avg_price, 1) OVER(PARTITION BY region ORDER BY year) as prev_year_price
    FROM FilteredAvgPrice
)
SELECT
    year,
    region,
    avg_price AS average_purchase_price,
    price_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN prev_year_price IS NULL OR prev_year_price = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (avg_price - prev_year_price) * 100 / prev_year_price
    END AS annual_percentage_change
FROM RankedAndLaggedPrice
ORDER BY year, price_rank;
